question: Can fine-tuning on one of nine known KISA misses recover the other eight without new errors?
authorization: User explicitly requested local additional training on one of the nine missed cases on 2026-10-04. Original evaluation is preserved; this diagnostic retires these known cases from independent-test claims.

design.folds: All nine seed-42 baseline misses, sorted by template_index, each used as the sole training example in one independent fold
design.reset: Reload untouched original checkpoint and reset random seed and optimizer for every fold
design.tokenizer: Exact local saved tokenizer; no fallback or remote download
design.schedule: constant learning rate; no scheduler, no early stopping
design.device: mps required; record actual torch/transformers versions; fail if unavailable
design.save_models: Save final step-10 checkpoint of every fold privately, never replace original

evaluation.support: Own trained example; report separately, exclude from held-out recovery
evaluation.primary: The other eight originally missed cases; report recovery count / 8 for each of nine folds
evaluation.group_guard: Require each support group to contain only that support case among all 22; otherwise fail before training
evaluation.retention: The 13 originally detected KISA cases; report newly missed cases
evaluation.normal_regression: 250 frozen existing development normal candidates; report total alerts, new alerts and resolved alerts relative to frozen baseline. Not independent or real-world FPR.
evaluation.all_22: May show training-included descriptive totals only, explicitly labeled
evaluation.all_21: Exclude trained case; known-cases diagnostic only
evaluation.no_selection: Report every fold and every predefined step. Do not choose a winner, change learning rate, epochs, thresholds or text using outcomes.
evaluation.aggregate: Nine folds reuse cases. Do not describe 72 held-out predictions as 72 independent messages.
evaluation.success_description: Completion requires honest results, not improved scores. Distinguish any recovery, all-eight recovery, and recovery without any new normal alert or lost KISA detection.

preflight: Freeze SHA256 of all protocol, runner, source inputs, original model and threshold report before inference or training
Check original source data counts, exact support IDs and singleton support groups; input text is never printed or included in public output
Replay all 22 KISA and 250 normal candidates; require saved decision equality and maximum probability difference <= 0.00001
Persist baseline and a lock/receipt before the first update; refuse overwrites and concurrent execution
Check all input and original-model hashes again on completion
privacy: No network, no SMS URL navigation, no new external API. Private inputs, row scores, losses and adapted weights remain in private directory mode 0700/files 0600. Public output contains pseudonymous K01-K22 codes and aggregate results only.
limitations: All cases were selected after observing existing errors; this is a retrospective adaptation diagnostic.
The eight evaluation misses are unseen by that fold's update but not new to the research project.
All nine missed messages exceeded 128 tokens in the existing diagnostic; retain original truncation for this experiment.
Single model seed and single fixed learning recipe; a negative result does not rule out other training methods.
Existing normal candidates include train/validation source rows and are not independently confirmed real normal SMS.
KISA labels remain source-provided smishing labels; no label edits and no claimed independent incident verification.
